newsitem.title: REPUBLIC OF IRELAND: Tullow says to merge oil and gas interests.
newsitem.headline: Tullow says to merge oil and gas interests.

text.p: Irish exploration group Tullow Oil Plc said on Thursday it proposes to merge its Czech oil and gas interests with the oil and gas interests of MOH Investments.
Tullow said in a statement the move, which was part of its continuing strategy of maximising the value of its assets, will be effected through a new holding company, Medusa Petroleum plc.
It said Medusa plans to raise up to 8.0 million pounds in new capital, one million of which will be subscribed by Tullow and it will have its shares traded on the Alternative Investment Market (AIM).
MOH is a private company with oil and gas interests in Poland, Spain, UK and elsewhere in Europe.
The merger of the Tullow interests and Tullow's subscription for shares are conditional on the successful listing of Medusa on AIM, the group said.
